name: Coffee Buns
source:
Set after the events of [url=/v25438]Mice Tea[/url], two years since the worldwide release of Kemono Tea, which turns the people who drink it into anthropomorphic animals. Society is still adjusting to the idea of real-life furries, but that doesn't mean you can skip your day-job.

Leonardo Bianco is a barista at a struggling café. His boss feels like hopping on the furry train might be just the thing to attract customers to the floundering business. Via a connection at another local business (which some returning readers might recognize), Leo and his co-workers are offered a chance to try transforming themselves. The tea works as advertised, but for Leo, there's more changes he didn't anticipate. 

[Edited from [url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/coffee-buns]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事背景设定在[url=/v25438]老鼠茶[/url]事件之后，距离兽野茶在全球范围内发布两年后，饮用它的人会变成拟人化的动物。社会仍在适应现实生活中兽迷的想法，但这并不意味着你可以跳过你的日常工作。

莱昂纳多·比安科 (Leonardo Bianco) 是一家苦苦挣扎的咖啡馆的咖啡师。他的老板觉得，跳上毛茸茸的火车可能正是吸引顾客来到这家陷入困境的企业的方法。通过与另一家当地企业的联系（一些回访的读者可能会认出），利奥和他的同事获得了尝试改变自己的机会。这种茶的功效正如广告中所宣传的那样，但对于Leo来说，还有更多他没有预料到的变化。

[编辑自[url=https://cinswitch.itch.io/coffee-buns]Itch.io[/url]]
